description: Claude review rules - configure what the assistant looks for before build

rules.name: Obvious Bugs
rules.description: Logic errors, off-by-one errors, null/None dereferences, infinite loops, unreachable code, wrong return types

rules.name: Hardcoded Secrets
rules.description: Passwords, API keys, tokens, private keys, or connection strings committed in source code

rules.name: Concurrency Issues
rules.description: Race conditions, missing locks, shared mutable state without synchronization, deadlock potential

rules.name: Error Handling Gaps
rules.description: Missing error handling on I/O or network calls, bare except/catch clauses, swallowed exceptions

rules.name: Code Smells
rules.description: Overly complex functions, poor naming, copy-paste duplication, functions doing too many things

rules.name: Design Concerns
rules.description: Tight coupling, single-responsibility violations, concerning architectural patterns, missing abstractions

rules.name: Quick Wins
rules.description: Simple improvements for clarity, maintainability, or idiomatic usage in the language

rules.name: SQL/Command Injection
rules.description: Unsanitized user input in SQL queries, subprocess calls, exec, eval, or template rendering

rules.name: Insecure Defaults
rules.description: HTTP instead of HTTPS, TLS verify disabled, overly permissive CORS, binding to 0.0.0.0, allowAll patterns

rules.name: Vulnerable Dependencies
rules.description: Importing known-deprecated or insecure libraries, pinning to known-vulnerable versions

rules.name: Resource Leaks
rules.description: Unclosed files, database connections, cursors, or sockets; missing finally/with/defer/using blocks

rules.name: Retry/Timeout Gaps
rules.description: Network or external service calls with no timeout set, no retry logic on flaky dependencies

rules.name: Data Loss Risk
rules.description: Destructive operations without confirmation, missing transactions on bulk writes, no backup before migration

rules.name: Logging Gaps
rules.description: No logging on error paths, sensitive data in log output, missing correlation or request IDs

rules.name: Config Hygiene
rules.description: Hardcoded URLs, ports, hostnames, or environment-specific values that should come from config or env vars

rules.name: Container Best Practices
rules.description: Running as root, no health checks, missing resource limits, using latest tags, large unnecessary layers

rules.name: Test Coverage Gaps
rules.description: New public functions, endpoints, or critical paths with no corresponding tests

rules.name: Breaking API Changes
rules.description: Renamed fields, removed endpoints, changed return types or signatures without versioning or migration path

rules.name: TODO/FIXME/HACK
rules.description: Temporary workarounds, TODO comments, FIXME markers, or HACK annotations that made it into a PR
